cat << 'EOF' > analyze_eu.py
import csv, math

rows = list(csv.DictReader(open("eu_economic_data.csv")))
eu = [r for r in rows if r["Country"] == "EU_Total"]
by_country_2024 = {r["Country"]: r for r in rows if r["Year"] == "2024" and r["Country"] != "EU_Total"}

# Cumulative real growth 2022->2024
def cum(series):
    p = 1.0
    for g in series: p *= (1 + float(g)/100)
    return (p - 1) * 100

eu_g = [float(r["GDP_Growth_Pct"]) for r in eu]
print("EU cumulative real growth 2022-24: %.1f%%" % cum(eu_g))
de_g = [float(r["GDP_Growth_Pct"]) for r in rows if r["Country"] == "Germany"]
es_g = [float(r["GDP_Growth_Pct"]) for r in rows if r["Country"] == "Spain"]
pl_g = [float(r["GDP_Growth_Pct"]) for r in rows if r["Country"] == "Poland"]
print("Germany cumulative: %.1f%% | Spain: %.1f%% | Poland: %.1f%%" % (cum(de_g), cum(es_g), cum(pl_g)))
print("US cumulative 2022-24 (BEA ~2.1/2.5/2.8): %.1f%%" % cum([2.1, 2.5, 2.8]))

print("EU trade balance improvement 22->24: %.1fB EUR (%.0f%% narrowing)" % (abs(-198.4 - -8.3), 100*abs(-198.4 - -8.3)/198.4))
print("EU inflation decline 22->24: %.1f pp" % (9.2-2.4))
print("EU debt decline 22->24: %.1f pp" % (84.0-80.1))
print("Germany share of EU GDP 2024: %.1f%%" % (4267.5/17655.7*100))
big4 = 4267.5+2922.8+2186.1+1567.3
print("Big-4 share of EU GDP 2024: %.1f%%" % (big4/17655.7*100))
g24 = sorted(by_country_2024.items(), key=lambda kv: -float(kv[1]["GDP_Growth_Pct"]))
print("2024 growth spread best->worst: %.1f pp" % (float(g24[0][1]["GDP_Growth_Pct"]) - float(g24[-1][1]["GDP_Growth_Pct"])))
print("2024 growth ranking:", [(c, r["GDP_Growth_Pct"]) for c, r in g24])
EOF
python3 analyze_eu.py
